prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] adoption_certificate_compact_layout_redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout with an interactive adoption badge and animated preview.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Adoption Certificate", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome_anim", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_starter_tips_hint: Add a reassuring hint above pet selection indicating that companions can be customized or changed at any time later.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can customize or add more desktop friends later at any time."}}
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_tips_wait_info: Display an estimated progress timer and revolving pet interaction tips on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
3: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_stage_layout_redesign: Redesign photo upload into a visual stage layout featuring clear photo picker UI components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Choose clear front-facing photos", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [finish, new_screen] home_intro_interaction_tips_new_screen: Insert a new screen `new_pet_controls_intro` before home_intro that demonstrates how to talk, hide, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls_intro", "home_intro"], "new_pet_controls_intro": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Click your pet to talk, right-click for quick actions, or drag to move them around your screen.", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:desktop_controls_demo", "style": "rounded"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to sign in with their original account method.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your original account method to restore existing pets and progress."}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_story_centered_redesign: Redesign the intro story screen using a centered layout with an animated mascot to capture user interest immediately.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:friendly_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Welcome! Choose how you want to create your desktop companion.", "style": "large"}]}}
7: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_quick_help_notification: Show a helpful sign-in status notification reminding users support is available if account connection stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Sign in to keep your pet synchronized across devices. Need help? Support is available."}}
8: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_first_look_copy: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain where to locate the pet on the desktop or system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look at the corner of your screen or check your system tray to start chatting with your pet right now."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] pick_friend_welcome_reward_incentive: Display a starter reward badge on the pet selection screen highlighting bonus starter pet treats included.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Pet Treats Pack", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate while maintaining the official certificate designation inside onboarding.
Adds a reassuring customization hint to the pet selection screen without violating rules.
Adds progress timer and tips to the waiting screen, which is allowed under onboarding rules.
Redesigns the photo upload layout while keeping the required photo picker functionality.
Inserts a valid new pet controls instruction screen inside the onboarding flow.
Adds a helpful sign-in hint for returning users without altering core functionality.
The redesigned story screen replaces the pet introduction job with choosing a path, losing the story screen's required purpose.
Adds a helpful support notification to the sign-in screen.
Updates home intro copy to explain pet placement without violating onboarding rules.
Onboarding copy mentions a 'Free Starter Pet Treats Pack', violating the rule against mentioning free extras, gifts, or pricing.
